title: AI / ML Engineer
description:

**Project Role Description :** Develops applications and systems that utilize AI tools, Cloud AI services, with proper cloud or on\-prem application pipeline with production ready quality. Be able to apply GenAI models as part of the solution. Could also include but not limited to deep learning, neural networks, chatbots, image processing.
  

**Must have skills :** Generative AI  

**Good to have skills :** NA  

Minimum **7\.5** year(s) of experience is required

As an AI / ML Engineer, a typical day involves designing and building advanced applications and systems that leverage artificial intelligence technologies. This role requires integrating cloud\-based or on\-premises pipelines to ensure solutions are production\-ready and scalable. The engineer works on implementing generative artificial intelligence models as part of comprehensive solutions, which may also encompass deep learning techniques, neural networks, conversational agents, and image processing tasks. Collaboration with various teams to align development efforts and maintain high\-quality deliverables is a key aspect of the daily routine.

* Mentor junior team members to foster skill development and knowledge sharing.

title: Enterprise App Admin II
description:
Join us in bringing joy to customer experience. Five9 is a leading provider of cloud contact center software, bringing the power of cloud innovation to customers worldwide.


Living our values everyday results in our team\-first culture and enables us to innovate, grow, and thrive while enjoying the journey together. We celebrate diversity and foster an inclusive environment, empowering our employees to be their authentic selves.



**About Five9**
---------------



Join us in bringing joy to customer experience. Five9 brings the power of AI and cloud innovation to customer experience software worldwide.



Living our values drives our team\-first culture, helping us innovate, grow, and thrive together.


**Role Overview**
-----------------



We are seeking an HR Applications Administrator to join our Business Technology / Enterprise Applications team, responsible for administering, configuring, and supporting the applications behind Five9's HR, Payroll, and Talent programs, primarily UKG (formerly UltiPro), with additional support for Deel, Greenhouse, and various other HR applications. This role partners closely with Human Resources, Payroll, Finance, Business Technology, InfoSec, and external vendors to keep our HR systems secure, reliable, and effective.



The ideal candidate has hands\-on UKG administration experience, along with a UKG Pro certification, strongly preferred. Candidates with substantial Workday administration experience and a Workday certification may also be a strong fit. This person communicates clearly, partners well across HR, Payroll, Finance, Business Technology, InfoSec, and vendor teams, and manages day\-to\-day administration independently.



The position is a hybrid role combining in\-office and work\-from\-home days, based in Chennai or Bengaluru, India, and requires regular overlap with United States business hours, including work until approximately 11:30 PM India Standard Time when needed.


**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------


* Administer and configure Five9's HR applications on a day\-to\-day basis, with primary focus on UKG Pro (formerly UltiPro), including system settings, business rules, and module configuration.
* Maintain system security roles, permissions, and access controls across HR applications to ensure appropriate data protection and compliance with company policy.
* Build, test, and maintain business process workflows, approval chains, and notifications within UKG Pro and related HR systems.
* Support and maintain integrations between UKG Pro, Deel, Greenhouse, Degreed Learning Experience Platform, Replicon, and other business applications, partnering with Business Technology teams as needed.
* Perform system testing, including validation of configuration changes, patches, and vendor releases prior to production deployment.
* Coordinate periodic vendor releases and platform updates, assessing impact to existing configuration and coordinating regression testing with stakeholders.
* Monitor data quality across HR systems, and identify, troubleshoot, and resolve data integrity issues.
* Build and maintain reports and dashboards to support HR, Payroll, and business stakeholder reporting needs.
* Maintain clear, current documentation of system configurations, processes, and support procedures.
* Provide day\-to\-day user support and troubleshooting for HR application end users, resolving issues in a timely manner.
* Manage vendor relationships for supported HR applications, including support tickets, escalations, and roadmap discussions.
* Support the AI Center of Excellence by identifying and helping implement opportunities to leverage AI to automate hire\-to\-retire and payroll\-related processes.
* Partner with Human Resources, Payroll, Finance, Business Technology, and InfoSec teams to gather requirements and implement solutions that meet business needs.

**Qualifications \& Skills**
----------------------------


### **Required Qualifications**


* A minimum of 5 years of experience administering enterprise Human Resources applications, with hands\-on UKG Pro (formerly UltiPro) experience as the primary qualification.
* Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
* Experience managing security roles, permissions, and access controls within an HRIS platform.
* Experience building and maintaining business process workflows, approval chains, and notifications.
* Experience supporting integrations between HR systems and other enterprise applications.
* Experience with system testing, including validating configuration changes and vendor releases prior to production deployment.
* Experience monitoring and maintaining data quality and data integrity across HR systems.
* Experience building reports and dashboards to support HR and business reporting needs.
* Strong documentation skills, with the ability to maintain clear and current process and configuration documentation.
* Experience providing end\-user support and troubleshooting for HR applications.
* Strong communication skills, with the ability to partner effectively with Human Resources, Payroll, Finance, Business Technology, InfoSec, and external vendors.
* Experience managing vendor relationships, including support escalations and coordination on releases.

### **Preferred Qualifications**


* UKG Pro certification (strongly preferred).
* Workday certification, for candidates whose primary HRIS administration experience is with Workday.
* Deel certification preferred.
* Experience with Greenhouse, Degreed Learning Experience Platform, or Replicon desired.
* Experience administering another major Human Resources Information System, supported by relevant qualifications or certifications.

**Why You'll Love This Role**
-----------------------------


* You will play a key role in supporting and evolving the technology that powers Five9's HR, Payroll, and Talent programs.
* You will work hands\-on with UKG Pro and gain exposure to a broader ecosystem of leading HR platforms.
* You will use cutting\-edge technologies, including AI, to help create great employee experiences.
* You will build strong partnerships across Human Resources, Payroll, Finance, Business Technology, InfoSec, and vendor teams.
* If you enjoy solving practical problems, safeguarding data quality, and delivering excellent support to HR technology users, this role offers strong opportunities to grow your HRIS expertise.
  


Five9 embraces diversity and is committed to building a team that represents a variety of backgrounds, perspectives, and skills. The more inclusive we are, the better we are. Five9 is an equal opportunity employer.



View our privacy policy, including our privacy notice to California residents here: https://www.five9\.com/pt\-pt/legal.  

  



Note: Five9 will never request that an applicant send money as a prerequisite for commencing employment with Five9\.

title: External Data Services Manager
description:
External Data Services Manager  

  

ICON is a global healthcare intelligence and clinical research organisation united by a mission to bring new medicines and treatments to patients faster.

  

  

As a values\-driven organisation, integrity, collaboration, agility, and inclusion are at the heart of how we work and interact with each other, customers, patients and suppliers.

  

  

Job Advert Posting
As an External Data Services Manager at ICON, you will be instrumental in leading the development and implementation of advanced data science solutions for clinical trials.


**What You Will Do:**

You will manage day\-to\-day clinical data science activities, supporting your team to deliver quality outcomes.
  

  

**Key responsibilities include:**

* Lead the development of Data Transfer Specifications (DTS) documents to align external data providers and research partners on the required structure for new data. This includes:
* Authoring the DTS, responding to external data providers and internal stakeholder queries to ensure
* data will be delivered in the correct format and structure.
* Track DTS status with external data providers across different data types and programs and ensure data completion dates are met for study timelines and deliverables.
* Ensuring data structure based on the type(s) of data being used is consistent and compliant with appropriate data templates.
* Ensuring data structure is consistent across each data provider and comply with appropriate data templates.
* Support data reconciliation and data structure inquiry resolution.
* Liaise cross functionally to facilitate the creation of new test codes.
* Participate in the Clinical Study Team as an extended team member.
* Oversee and train in the use of the DTS and other supplemental documents.
* Contribute to improvement initiatives as it relates to external data process.
* Ensure study teams adhere to CDISC standards as it relates to external data.
* Comply with all pertinent regulatory agency requirements (Understand clinical protocols and requirement for Biomarkers/Imaging/eCOA data, blinding and analysis expectations).
* Process change requests to update existing DTS.
* Improve templates for existing DTS to ensure data harmonization and downstream analytics.
* Provide external data management oversight to vendors, providing a pathway for functional discussions, partnership level processes \& standards, portfolio status, communication, and escalation.
* Review and contribute to eCRF and EDC builds as it relates to external data requirements.

**Your Profile:**

You will have solid clinical data science experience, with the ability to manage competing priorities and develop your team.
  

  

**Required qualifications and experience:**

* Minimum 8\+ years of experience in external data services
* Expertise in biomarker data types and/or Imaging data for oncology and non\-oncology studies is preferred
* Experience working with multiple data types/formats
* Experience in managing clinical, biomarker data, eCOA and imaging data
* Demonstrates broad knowledge of all applicable regulations including 21 CFR
* Part 11, ICH\-GCP Guidelines and CDISC standards for data collections.
* Demonstrates advanced knowledge of Data Management processes and industry best practices.
* Advanced knowledge and experience with extracting data into SAS, CSV, and
* XML formats is required.
  

Employment with ICON is contingent upon having the legal right to work in the country where the role is based.

  

  

**Rewards \& Benefits**

ICON offers a competitive and comprehensive total rewards package designed to support your health, wellbeing, and career development.

  

  

Benefits may include:


* Competitive base salary and performance related incentives
* Health and wellbeing programmes including medical, dental, and vision coverage where applicable
* Retirement and pension plans
* Life assurance and disability coverage
* Employee assistance programmes and wellbeing resources
* Learning and development opportunities through structured training and career pathways
  

  

Benefits may vary depending on role and location.

  

  

Visit our careers site to read more about the benefits ICON offers.

  

  

**Inclusion and Accessibility**

ICON is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to building an inclusive and accessible workplace where everyone feels valued and supported.

  

  

If you require reasonable accommodations during the recruitment process, please let us know or submit a **request** .

title: Amazon Marketplace Specialist – E-Commerce
description:
Sportstech is looking for an experienced and hands\-on **Amazon Marketplace Specialist** to manage and optimize our product listings across Amazon and other major European marketplaces.

You will take ownership of Amazon listings—from creating complex product variations and optimizing product content to resolving suppressed listings, blocked ASINs, catalogue conflicts, and account\-health issues.

You will also work closely with account managers and internal teams, participate in regular meetings, prepare performance reports, and use AI tools to improve marketplace workflows and team efficiency.

This position is ideal for someone with strong practical Amazon experience who knows how to respond when a listing breaks, a product is suppressed, or an ASIN is blocked.

Key ResponsibilitiesAmazon Listing Management

* Create, maintain, and optimize product listings through Amazon Seller Central and Vendor Central.
* Build complex listings, including parent\-child variations for sizes, colours, and bundles.
* Create and manage A\+ Content, Enhanced Brand Content, and Amazon Brand Store pages.
* Maintain the quality of product titles, bullet points, descriptions, backend keywords, images, and attributes.
* Conduct keyword research and continuously optimize listings for search visibility and conversion.
* Manage bulk product uploads using flat files and inventory templates.

Problem Resolution and Account Health

* Independently resolve suppressed listings, blocked or locked ASINs, category errors, attribute issues, hijacked listings, and content disputes.
* Open, manage, follow up, and escalate cases with Amazon Seller Support until they are fully resolved.
* Monitor account\-health metrics and proactively prevent policy violations.
* Handle catalogue conflicts, Brand Registry issues, and compliance\-documentation requests.

Multi\-Platform Marketplace Management

* Support listing creation and maintenance across European marketplaces such as Otto, Kaufland, Decathlon, and MediaMarkt/Saturn.
* Adapt product content and data according to each marketplace’s requirements.
* Investigate and resolve platform\-specific listing and catalogue issues.

Reporting and Sales Analysis

* Prepare and maintain sales and marketplace performance reports.
* Analyse sales, traffic, conversion rates, Buy Box performance, and product rankings.
* Identify trends, risks, and opportunities and provide actionable recommendations.
* Work confidently with Microsoft Excel, including pivot tables, VLOOKUP/XLOOKUP, data cleaning, and large datasets.

Communication and Collaboration

* Communicate proactively and professionally with account managers and internal teams.
* Participate actively in regular team meetings and video calls.
* Document marketplace processes, issues, and solutions in a structured and transparent manner.

AI\-Supported Workflows

Using modern AI tools as part of daily marketplace operations is an important requirement for this position.

* Use Claude, ChatGPT, Grok, or similar AI tools for listing creation, translation, keyword research, case communication, data analysis, and workflow automation.
* Stay updated on new AI tools and marketplace technologies.
* Proactively recommend ways to improve team productivity and operational efficiency through AI.

Required Qualifications

* At least 2–5 years of professional experience as an Amazon Specialist, Marketplace Manager, or in a comparable role.
* Strong hands\-on knowledge of Amazon Seller Central; Vendor Central experience is preferred.
* Proven experience creating complex Amazon listings, parent\-child variations, A\+ Content, and flat\-file uploads.
* Demonstrated ability to resolve suppressed listings, blocked ASINs, catalogue issues, and other Amazon account problems.
* Strong Microsoft Excel skills.
* Practical experience using Claude, ChatGPT, Grok, or comparable AI tools in daily workflows.
* Strong analytical skills and experience evaluating marketplace sales and performance data.
* Excellent written and spoken English communication skills.
* Self\-driven, structured, reliable, and comfortable working remotely.

Preferred Qualifications

* Experience with European marketplaces such as Otto, Kaufland, Decathlon, MediaMarkt/Saturn, bol.com, or eBay.
* Basic knowledge of Amazon PPC and Amazon Advertising.
* Experience using tools such as Helium 10, Jungle Scout, Sellerboard, or similar platforms.
* Experience working with PIM or ERP systems, such as Plentymarkets.
* German\-language skills are advantageous but not mandatory.

title: Engineering Manager
description:
At ABB, we help industries run leaner and cleaner—and every person here makes that happen. You’ll be empowered to lead, supported to grow, and proud of the impact we create together. Join us and help run what runs the world.



This Position reports to:



Senior Engineering Manager \#\#\#



In this role, you will have the opportunity to lead and support engineering activities in all types of project sizes and complexities. Each day, you will complete the tasks cost\-effectively and in accordance with contract specifications, quality standards, safety requirements, and cybersecurity policies and standards. You will also highlight your expertise by collecting data and supporting production of engineering design.



The work model for the role is \# LI \- Hybrid.



This role is contributing to the to the Process Automation business in Energy Industries division based in Bangalore, India.


**You will be mainly accountable for:**


* Engineering, testing, commissioning, and lifecycle support of Power Management Systems (PMS), including load shedding, load sharing, synchronization, and monitoring/control of primary electrical equipment.
* Designing, developing, and integrating DCS/SCADA solutions, including controller configuration, application engineering, HMI development, graphics creation, and system software implementation.
* Developing and implementing power system control philosophies, ensuring reliable and efficient operation of industrial power and automation systems.
* Configuring and integrating IEDs, protection relays, protocol gateways, and data concentrators, including management of IEC 61850 engineering files (ICD, CID, and SCD).
* Designing and maintaining industrial control system network architectures, ensuring robust communication between field devices, controllers, and enterprise systems.
* Implementing and troubleshooting industrial communication protocols such as IEC 61850, Modbus, OPC, DNP3, IEC 101/104, TCP/IP, Profinet, and Fieldbus.
* Executing FAT, IFAT, SAT, and commissioning activities, while preparing and maintaining engineering documentation from basic design through detailed engineering stages.
* Supporting OT/IT integration, industrial cybersecurity, system maintenance, backup strategies, and asset performance improvement initiatives, including renewable energy and asset reliability solutions where applicable.


You will join a talented team, where you will be able to thrive.


**Qualifications for the role:**


* Minimum 15\&\#43; years of experience in Power Management Systems (PMS), Power Systems, Substation Automation, DCS/SCADA engineering, or a related industrial automation domain, including experience in planning and project execution roles.
* Proven experience in providing technical solutions, engineering leadership, and system integration expertise for complex industrial, utility, or energy sector projects.
* Demonstrated people management and project management experience, with the ability to lead multidisciplinary engineering teams and drive project delivery.
* Strong experience in executing international and domestic projects, including engineering, testing, commissioning, customer coordination, and site support activities.
* Sound understanding of power systems, industrial automation, communication networks, and control system architectures, with the ability to manage technical and commercial project requirements.
* Excellent verbal and written communication, stakeholder management, and customer\-facing skills, with the ability to effectively collaborate across global teams.
* Bachelor’s degree in electrical, Electronics, Instrumentation, Automation, or a related Engineering discipline.
* Willingness to travel 30\-50% nationally and internationally as required for project execution, commissioning, customer engagements, and business support activities. A valid international passport is mandatory.


**More about us**



ABB a provides a comprehensive range of integrated automation, electrical and digital systems and services for customers in the process, hybrid and maritime industries. These offerings, coupled with deep domain knowledge in each end market, help to optimize productivity, energy efficiency, sustainability and safety of industrial processes and operations.



The Energy Industries Division serves a wide range of industrial sectors, including hydrocarbons, chemicals, pharmaceuticals, power generation and water. With its integrated solutions that automate, digitalize and electrify operations, the Division is committed to supporting traditional industries in their efforts to decarbonize. The Division also supports the development, integration and scaling up of new and renewable energy models. The Division’s goal is to help customers adapt and succeed in the rapidly changing global energy transition. Harnessing data, machine learning and artificial intelligence (AI), the Division brings over 50 years of domain expertise delivering solutions designed to improve energy, process and production efficiency, as well as reduce risk, operational cost and capital cost, while minimizing waste for customers, from project start\-up and throughout the entire plant lifecycle.



Building a cleaner, smarter future takes all kinds of minds: the curious, the courageous, and the creative. We welcome people from all backgrounds and experiences.



Ready to make an impact? Apply today or visit www.abb.com to learn more about the impact of our solutions across the globe.

title: Relationship Manager
description:
**Some careers open more doors than others.**

  

If you’re looking for a career that will unlock new opportunities, join HSBC and experience the possibilities. Whether you want a career that could take you to the top, or simply take you in an exciting new direction, HSBC offers opportunities, support and rewards that will take you further.

 **Business Description:**

  



HSBC Corporate and Institutional Banking is a markets\-led, financing\-focused business that provides investment and financial solutions. Through our international network, we connect emerging and mature markets, covering key growth areas. We partner with our corporate, government and institutional clients to help them achieve consistent, long\-term performance. Our products and services include advisory, financing, prime services, research and analysis, securities services, trading and sales and transaction banking.

 **International Mid\-Market (IMM)**


International Mid\-market division provides international financial services/ solutions that support businesses ranging from large corporates to mid\-market enterprises in a variety of industry sectors all over the world. Leveraging the strength, scope and expertise of our global product network, IMM is positioned as an essential partner to large and mid\-market enterprises seeking to maximise their potential internationally, offering streamlined business access to HSBC’s international network and broad range of market leading banking products and services.

 **Principal Responsibilities**


The position, based in Chennai, a strategic business location for IMM team to cover the clients in the region. This market has been identified as a strategic market for us and has seen lot of activity and good success in last few years and needs to be built upon.

* The jobholder’s primary responsibility will be to achieve revenue targets, target new to bank customers, identify new to product customers from the existing customer base, and to develop and manage these relationships. The products on offer to these clients include working capital finance, term lending including external commercial borrowing, structured trade solution, transaction banking/ payment solutions, treasury solutions, overseas banking solutions besides capital market and investment banking proposition.
* The jobholder will be working on local Large and Mid\-sized Corporates based in Chennai.
* The jobholder is expected to contribute to the development as well as execution of the strategy to differentiate HSBC from competitors.
* More specific expectation from the candidate would be to do the following:

* Drive acquisition of new clients. One of the jobholder’s key KPI will be to significantly grow the Bank’s business in a specified turnover segment. The candidate will have to drive growth in asset and liability book in\-country along with growing the outbound business for the target clientele.
* To be the primary relationship manager for the assigned portfolio of existing customer base and to achieve account profitability targets through focused marketing efforts.
* To co\-ordinate marketing efforts with various product teams (Cash management, Trade, Treasury, Investment Banking, etc) to ensure an increased wallet share and that individual product targets are met.
* Contribute to the creation of new business opportunities for the bank
* Ensure that positive customer relationships is fostered and increase visibility in the marketplace
* Candidate is expected to possess the following:  

	+ Possess strong credit skills to ensure quality of the credit is maintained across existing portfolio and new acquisitions
* Possess ability to analyze financial statements, cash flows, industries, trade and Working Capital cycles, etc
* To ensure that the credit quality of the existing and newly acquired relationships is in line with the Bank’s acceptable credit parameters
* Be well versed with related regulatory policies, guidelines etc

 **Qualifications**

* CA/MBA from reputed institution
* Minimum experience of 8\-10 years in Banking and 4\-5 years as a relationship manager in similar role.

 **Additional Notes :**

  

Familiarity with AI\-enabled tools is an advantage.


Mandatory to successfully complete Anti\-Money Laundering and Sanctions training and post\-course assessment, as required

  

You’ll achieve more at HSBC.


HSBC is committed to building a culture where all employees are valued, respected and opinions count. We take pride in providing a workplace that fosters continuous professional development, flexible working and opportunities to grow within an inclusive and diverse environment.

  

Personal data held by the Bank relating to employment applications will be used in accordance with our Privacy Statement, which is available on our website.

title: Customised pc building
description:
Job Summary

We are looking for a detail\-oriented and tech\-savvy Custom PC Builder to join our team. You will turn client requirements into high\-performance gaming rigs, professional workstations, or specialized editing computers. Your work covers everything from physical assembly and clean cable management to BIOS updates and system stress testing.

Key Responsibilities

* **PC Assembly:** Put together custom hardware components including CPUs, GPUs, motherboards, RAM, storage drives, power supplies, and air/liquid cooling systems. \[1]
* **Cable Management:** Route and secure cables neatly to optimize internal airflow and visual aesthetics.
* **Software Configuration:** Install operating systems (Windows, Linux), necessary drivers, and requested applications.
* **Testing \& Diagnostics:** Run benchmark and stress tests to ensure thermal stability, performance output, and overall system reliability.
* **Troubleshooting:** Identify and replace faulty hardware or resolve configuration conflicts during and after the build process.
* **Client Consultation:** Work with sales or directly with customers to verify hardware compatibility and suggest optimal parts for specific use cases (e.g., gaming, machine learning, video production).
* **Workstation Maintenance:** Keep the build area clean, ESD\-safe (Electrostatic Discharge), and organized.

Pay: ₹11,000\.00 \- ₹25,000\.00 per month
